title: The goat for the sick son

plan.english: Wise one, sickness has seized my son. Will he live? Lead a goat to me. I shall cut it and see its liver. What do you see in the liver? The liver is whole, and there is no blood in it. He will live. What shall I give you? Give the meat of the goat to the gods, and the skin to me.

title: The white horse running to the dawn

plan.english: Dear friend, in sleep I caught sight of a white horse. Where did the horse run? It ran toward the dawn, and it did not come back. A white horse is fame. Your fame will be imperishable. May the gods hear your words! They hear them; Dyēus hears all things. Let us drink mead, friend!

title: The dream of the whole ox

plan.english: Sister, I have seen a great dream. Say it! Was a god speaking to you? A god was not speaking; I was eating a whole ox at a feast. When you woke up, what did you do? I was hungry, and I ate up the grain of my brother. Then your dream was true: you ate up a feast. Our brother will not laugh.

title: The dog that cried all night
